title: LCARdS Layout View
description: Dashboard view type whose whole view is a CSS grid. Uses the lovelace-layout-card grid-layout schema: a `layout` block plus `cards` placed by `view_layout.grid-area`.

margin.description: Margin around the grid: a CSS length (e.g. 8px, 1rem 0) or 0

padding.description: Padding inside the grid: a CSS length (e.g. 8px, 1rem 0) or 0

card_margin.description: Margin around each card in the grid: a CSS length (e.g. 8px, 1rem 0) or 0

cards.description: Cards placed in the grid. Each is any HA card config; `view_layout` places it in a grid area.

grid-column.description: CSS grid-column: a line number (2), a span ("span 2") or a range ("1 / 3").

grid-row.description: CSS grid-row: a line number (3), a span ("span 2") or a range ("2 / 4").
